shell.readOnly: The subscription is suspended: you can view data but not record anything new.

auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to follow your cars, money and partners.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.resetSent: If this email is registered, a link will arrive within a few minutes.
auth.passwordRules: At least 10 characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter and a digit.
auth.linkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.

tenants.title: Choose a showroom
tenants.none: Your account is not linked to any showroom yet. Ask the showroom owner for an invitation.

dashboard.comingNext: The money and stock dashboard and the Needs Attention panel will appear here in the next phases.

users.name: Name
users.title: Users
users.inviteHint: Someone who already has an account in another showroom is added right away. Others receive an email to set their password.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.body: This link is wrong or you don't have access to it.

errors.UNKNOWN_ERROR: Something unexpected happened. Please try again.
errors.NETWORK_ERROR: Cannot reach the server. If you are running the system locally, make sure the API is running (scripts/dev.ps1 api) and try again.
errors.INTERNAL_ERROR: The server had a problem. Please try again shortly.
errors.AUTH_INVALID_TOKEN: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.TENANT_ACCESS_DENIED: You don't have access to this showroom.
errors.PERMISSION_DENIED: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.TENANT_READ_ONLY: The subscription is suspended; new records cannot be saved.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some information is missing or invalid.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The requested item was not found.
errors.MEMBER_ALREADY_EXISTS: This person is already a member of the showroom.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The showroom must keep at least one active owner.
errors.INVITE_FAILED: The invitation could not be sent. Please try again.
errors.INVITES_DISABLED: Invitations are not enabled on the server.
errors.auth_weak_password: Password too weak. Use at least 10 characters with upper and lower case letters and a digit.
errors.auth_over_request_rate_limit: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.auth_same_password: Choose a password different from the old one.
errors.PERIOD_LOCKED: This month is locked. Post into an open month or ask the owner to unlock it.
errors.CASH_INSUFFICIENT: Not enough money in this account.
errors.DATE_IN_FUTURE: The date cannot be in the future.
errors.CATEGORY_INVALID: Choose an active general expense category.
errors.CASH_ACCOUNT_INVALID: The cash box or bank account does not exist or is archived.
errors.ENTRY_ALREADY_REVERSED: This entry has already been reversed.
errors.ENTRY_IS_REVERSAL: A reversal cannot be reversed. Record the correct transaction instead.
errors.LEDGER_IMMUTABLE: Posted entries cannot be edited; reverse and re-enter instead.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: Something referenced does not exist in this showroom.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED: This request was already sent with different data. Reopen the form.
errors.IDEMPOTENCY_IN_PROGRESS: Still recording. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.CASH_ACCOUNT_NOT_EMPTY: An account with a balance cannot be archived. Transfer the balance first.
errors.ACCOUNT_LIMIT_REACHED: The maximum number of accounts in this group has been reached.
errors.PDF_UNAVAILABLE: PDF is not available on this server right now. Use Excel.
errors.DATE_RANGE_INVALID: The start date is after the end date.

finance.noAccounts: No cash box or bank account yet. Add them in Settings.
finance.amountInvalid: Enter an amount greater than zero, with at most 2 decimals.

periods.title: Month lock
periods.hint: Nothing can be posted or reversed inside a locked month. Corrections go into an open month.
